rules.execution: One atomic task at a time; validate and persist each TaskResult before the next task.
rules.mutation: Only ApplyProjectMutation commits an edit. All analysis and rewrite tools are read-only or proposal-only.
rules.evidence: Every factual output cites persisted evidence IDs and preserves uncertainty.
rules.commands: No semantic tool accepts arbitrary shell text.

tools.name: ProbeMedia
tools.when: Phase 0 after local-path validation
tools.validation: Supported local file, successful ffprobe JSON

tools.name: CreateWorkingManifest
tools.when: Phase 0 after rights attestation and probing
tools.input: Project ID, attestation, source hash, probe and disk estimate
tools.validation: Accepted versioned attestation, SHA-256, sufficient disk

tools.name: DetectShots
tools.when: Phase 2 deterministic preprocessing

tools.name: MeasureFrameSimilarity
tools.when: Suppressing near-duplicate candidate frames

tools.name: MeasureMotion
tools.when: Choosing denser sampling around movement

tools.name: SelectRepresentativeFrames
tools.when: After shot/similarity/motion analysis
tools.input: Scene range, metrics and hardware caps
tools.validation: Frame count/dimensions within selected model tier

tools.name: ExtractTemporalWindow
tools.when: A user or validator requests bounded media context
tools.input: Source reference, center/range and stream selection

tools.name: DetectFaces
tools.when: Phase 3 on representative frames

tools.name: ComputeFaceEmbedding
tools.when: A detected crop is suitable for continuity comparison

tools.name: MatchKnownCharacter
tools.when: Comparing a face with existing project clusters
tools.output: Probable cluster match or unknown with score

tools.name: AssignEntityName
tools.when: Explicit dialogue, label, credit, metadata or user evidence establishes a name
tools.input: Entity ID, name, establishment time, provenance and confidence
tools.validation: Explicit evidence; no facial identity inference; no retroactive spoiler

tools.name: ExtractAudioChunk
tools.when: Phase 1 after signal/VAD segmentation
tools.input: Source reference, absolute start/end and analysis format
tools.validation: Source audio untouched; overlap within policy

tools.name: TranscribeChunk
tools.when: Whisper is loaded for one bounded chunk
tools.validation: Timestamps map inside chunk and source

tools.name: MergeTranscriptChunks
tools.when: All available chunk results are persisted

tools.name: DetectDialogueAndSilenceWindows
tools.when: Phase 1 after signal analysis/transcript
tools.output: Dialogue, meaningful sound and candidate gap map
tools.validation: Do not equate all non-speech with safe narration

tools.name: GetTranscriptInterval
tools.when: A task needs transcript context

tools.name: GetScene
tools.when: A task names a scene ID

tools.name: FindSceneByTime
tools.when: A user supplies a timestamp

tools.name: GetRelevantFrames
tools.when: Visual evidence is needed
tools.validation: Extract more only when persisted evidence is insufficient

tools.name: ExtractAdditionalFrames
tools.when: Explicit evidence gap remains after GetRelevantFrames
tools.validation: Hardware cap, project source and justified request

tools.name: AnalyzeVisualSequence
tools.when: Phase 5 or targeted visual question
tools.input: Bounded scene package and analyst prompt version

tools.name: AnalyzeSceneSemantics
tools.when: Relating verified visuals to transcript/source sound

tools.name: RunVlmOcr
tools.when: Meaningful visual text may exist
tools.validation: Mark uncertainty; never assume exact spelling

tools.name: RunTesseractOcr
tools.when: Exact literal text matters or VLM confidence is low/conflicting

tools.name: ReconcileOcrResults
tools.when: VLM/Tesseract readings require evidence-based reconciliation
tools.validation: Retain material alternatives; request better frame when needed

tools.name: IdentifyPeopleObjectsActions
tools.when: Structuring verified scene observations

tools.name: TrackEstablishedEntities
tools.when: Updating recurring project context

tools.name: FindDescriptionOpportunity
tools.when: Phase 6 accessibility-need scoring
tools.input: Scene, dialogue, source sound and visual significance
tools.validation: No cue solely for a cut/object; protect crucial sound

tools.name: DraftAdSegment
tools.when: A validated opportunity requires description
tools.input: Verified facts, name timeline, audio context and time budget

tools.name: RewriteAdSegment
tools.when: User requests or validation requires a bounded rewrite
tools.input: Committed segment, requested change and same evidence

tools.name: CheckForSpoilers
tools.when: Before any draft/edit can be committed
tools.validation: Knowledge available at interval time only

tools.name: CheckRedundancy
tools.when: Before any draft/edit can be committed
tools.input: Proposal, nearby AD, dialogue and source sound

tools.name: ValidateNarrationWindow
tools.when: Before synthesis and after measured synthesis
tools.input: Segment timing, dialogue/sound map and duration
tools.validation: No overlaps; protect crucial source sound

tools.name: EstimateSpeechDuration
tools.when: Before first synthesis
tools.input: Text and selected Piper voice rate

tools.name: SynthesizeNarration
tools.when: Approved segment needs audio
tools.input: Text, licensed voice and synthesis settings

tools.name: MeasureRenderedNarration
tools.when: Immediately after synthesis

tools.name: AutoFitNarrationToWindow
tools.when: Measured narration exceeds a validated window
tools.validation: Bounded retries; unresolved result requires review

tools.name: GenerateAudioPreview
tools.when: Reviewing one or more committed narration segments
tools.validation: Preserve crucial source sound and prevent clipping

tools.name: GenerateVideoPreview
tools.when: Visual/audio review requires video
tools.validation: Defaults to committed state; source untouched

tools.name: ApplyProjectMutation
tools.when: A validated proposal has explicit user approval or authorized deterministic policy
tools.input: Expected project version and validated change
tools.validation: Authorization, optimistic concurrency and complete validation

tools.name: CreateCheckpoint
tools.when: A durable phase/task output validates successfully
tools.input: Project, phase, manifest and output hash
tools.validation: Referenced artifacts exist and hashes match

tools.name: UndoLastMutation
tools.when: User asks to undo the latest reversible edit

tools.name: RestoreCheckpoint
tools.when: User selects a valid historic checkpoint
tools.input: Project, checkpoint and expected current version

tools.name: ValidateProject
tools.when: Before preview/finalization/publication and on demand
tools.validation: All media, timing, identity, audio and mutation invariants

tools.name: MixNarrationTrack
tools.when: Preview or final render passed validation
tools.input: Original audio and timed narration assets
tools.validation: No overlap/click/clipping and crucial sound preserved

tools.name: RenderFinalVideo
tools.when: Final validation has no blocking errors or approved nonblocking override
tools.input: Committed project and validated audio mix
tools.validation: Refuse blockers; stream-copy suitable video; never overwrite source

tools.name: PublishToYouTube
tools.when: User explicitly chooses publication and confirms authenticated channel/visibility
tools.input: Final local MP4 and OAuth channel identity
tools.validation: Creator entitlement, narrow scopes, final hash, explicit channel

tools.name: RefreshYouTubeStatus
tools.when: Reconciling publication availability
tools.output: Independent availability flags and audit event

tools.name: ExportProjectPackage
tools.when: User requests a portable project export

tools.name: CleanupProjectIntermediates
tools.when: Artifacts are no longer needed or user requests cleanup
tools.validation: Never delete source, final output or downstream-required data
